entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I need to start a return for some cycling shoes I bought about a month ago.
I can certainly look into that for you. To clarify, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or a preference matter?
It's a fit issue. I've tried adjusting the cleats multiple times, but I keep getting terrible blisters on my heels after every ride. They're just not working for my feet.
I'm sorry to hear that the shoes are causing blisters; that's definitely not the experience we want for our customers. I just need to pull up your order. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF881903.
Thank you, Alex. I see the order here for the Sonic Pro cycling shoes, delivered on November 15th. That was 34 days ago. Just one moment while I check the policy for you.

Alright, I've checked. Since you're within our 90-day return window for standard items, I can absolutely process that full refund for you. I've just emailed you a prepaid return label. Just package the shoes in their original box and drop it off at any post office.

Okay, a full refund is great, I appreciate that. Now, since I had to go through this whole process and the shoes were frankly unusable for me, is there any chance you could offer a discount code for my next purchase? I'd still like to try a different model from VeloFit.

I understand your position, and I'm glad you're willing to give another one of our products a try. However, our policy is to provide the full refund for the item, but we aren't able to offer additional discounts or credits on top of that. The refund is the complete resolution for the return.
I see. No small credit for the inconvenience, then? Just checking all the options.

I'm afraid not, but I can assure you that once we receive the returned cycling shoes, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thanks for your help, Sarah.
You're very welcome, Alex. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
